title: Your PC takes forever to start? Do this
caption:
Your PC takes forever to start... and this is why 🐢

Every app you install wants to launch with Windows.
✅ Press Ctrl + Shift + Esc
✅ Click Startup apps
✅ Check the Startup impact column
✅ Right-click the High ones you don't need > Disable

How long does your PC take to start? 👇
